scope: throwaway probe package under plugin-packages/ (removed on completion)

tasks.title: Determine the hook event vocabulary the daimon accepts
tasks.detail: The CLI docs describe event/matcher/command/timeout, same fields as config.toml hooks. Identify a concrete event name before writing the probe; a wrong event name would produce a false negative.
tasks.verify: a named event with its source

tasks.title: Build and install the probe package
tasks.detail: Minimal manifest with a hooks rule (inert append-to-file command) and a systemPrompt sentinel. Must not affect the shipping prometheus-skill-pack package.
tasks.verify: package present; Kimi Desktop still starts

tasks.title: Record both verdicts
tasks.detail: Restart Kimi Desktop. Check the hook artifact file. For systemPrompt, do NOT rely on asking the model to repeat a sentinel — a refusal or a miss does not prove the field was ignored. Use a positive control instead: include a field already PROVEN to work in this package (skills), confirm the package loaded, and only then treat a sentinel miss as evidence. Record fires / does-not-fire / inconclusive per field.
tasks.verify: two verdicts, each one of fires|does-not-fire|inconclusive, with the evidence and the positive-control result

tasks.title: Remove the probe and update the assessment
tasks.detail: Delete the probe package from plugin-packages/. Update assessment.md E4/E5 from 'unproven' to the measured verdict.
tasks.verify: probe absent; assessment.md reflects the verdict
